references.title: 使用者の責に帰すべき事由による休業 (労働基準法 art.26: 休業手当 60% of the 平均賃金 (art.12) per scheduled day; excluded from the 全労働日 of the annual-leave 80% test, 平成25年7月10日 基発0710第3号) The 平均賃金 leaves out the periods art.12(3) lists, their days and their wages: occupational injury absence, 産前産後休業, an employer-caused suspension (the EMPLOYER_CAUSED work event only, with the 休業手当 paid for it), 育児休業 (incl. 出生時育児休業), 介護休業 (the balance's leave and suspension days) and the probation period (terms.probation_period.to, its wages prorated by calendar days); where they cover the whole three months the wages and days of the period are used undivided (施行規則 art.3; 昭和24年4月11日 基発421号), and a worker paid by the day or hour is guaranteed 60% of the three months’ wages over the days worked (art.12(1)(i); the recorded worked days).

description: An employer-caused event that changes work or pay.

references.title: 天災事変その他の不可抗力による休業 (no 休業手当: not attributable to the employer, 労働基準法 art.26; excluded from the 全労働日, 基発0710第3号; e.g. a natural disaster or a scheduled power cut, 平成23年3月15日 基監発0315第1号)

description: A force-majeure event that stops work; pay follows the agreed stoppage terms.

references.title: 正当な争議行為（同盟罷業）による不就労 (no wage for the days not worked, 民法 art.624(1); excluded from the 全労働日, 基発0710第3号; non-strikers idled by a partial strike are not owed 休業手当, 最判昭和62年7月17日)

description: A strike stops work; participant pay follows the agreement.

references.title: 正当なロックアウト (a defensive lockout releases the wage duty, 最判昭和50年4月25日 丸島水門事件; excluded from the 全労働日, 基発0710第3号; an unjustified lockout is EMPLOYER_CAUSED)

description: An employer lockout stops work; pay follows the agreed terms.

references.title: 法令・行政命令による休業 (a closure or work restriction ordered under law, e.g. 感染症法 art.18 就業制限: not attributable to the employer, no 休業手当; excluded from the 全労働日 as force majeure, 基発0710第3号)

description: A government order stops work; the day stays scheduled and attended.

references.title: Annual leave attendance for employer wrongful refusal or invalid dismissal
references.quote: A period the employee could not work because of wrongful employer refusal, including a dismissal established invalid, remains in total working days and is deemed attended. This attendance category does not compute the separate back-wage liability.

description: A wrongful refusal to provide work.
